acquisition.description: One data.sec.gov submissions request per CIK. CIK universe snapshot: https://www.sec.gov/files/company_tickers_exchange.json retrieved 2026-09-15 (Last-Modified 2026-09-14). Only the 'recent' filing array (<=1000 filings or 1 year) is fetched; older overflow pages are not. Size note: the plan estimate (500 MB, unverified) was low; 4,212 of 8,022 CIKs (CIK order) used 524 MB, because long-lived filers carry up to 1,000 recent filings (~124 KB mean), so desired_bytes was raised to 900 MB.

coverage.scope: Submissions JSON (recent filings array) for all 8,022 CIKs in SEC company_tickers_exchange.json on 2026-09-14

definition.description: SEC EDGAR submissions JSON for every CIK in company_tickers_exchange.json (8,022 issuers with tickers on Nasdaq/NYSE/CBOE/OTC as of 2026-09-14): names, former names, tickers, exchanges, SIC, state of incorporation, fiscal year end and recent filing index

sampling.criteria: Single Apple CIK submission metadata record; recent filing arrays retained as source payload but not normalized into filing or obligation claims.

source.license_notes: US federal government work; no redistribution restriction. Declared User-Agent with contact required; <=10 requests/second.

rights.interpretation: Source metadata inventory; compatibility and derivative-work obligations are not automatically adjudicated.
